_meta.source: AICPA Trust Services Criteria — Common Criteria (Security). Criterion text is a SUMMARY, not the verbatim AICPA TSC; verify against the official Trust Services Criteria before audit use. Only the required Common Criteria (CC series) are modeled; Availability/Confidentiality/Processing Integrity/Privacy are not yet included.
_meta.verification: VERIFY criterion wording and scope against the AICPA TSC 2017 (rev. 2022).

CC1.1.title: Integrity and ethical values
CC1.1.control: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.

objectives.text: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.

CC1.2.title: Board oversight
CC1.2.control: The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight of internal control.

objectives.text: The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight of internal control.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight of internal control.

CC1.3.title: Structure and authority
CC1.3.control: Management establishes structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities and responsibilities.

objectives.text: Management establishes structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities and responsibilities.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that management establishes structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities and responsibilities.

CC1.4.title: Competence
CC1.4.control: The entity demonstrates a commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals.

objectives.text: The entity demonstrates a commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity demonstrates a commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals.

CC1.5.title: Accountability
CC1.5.control: The entity holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities.

objectives.text: The entity holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities.

CC2.1.title: Quality information
CC2.1.control: The entity obtains or generates relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control.

objectives.text: The entity obtains or generates relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity obtains or generates relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control.

CC2.2.title: Internal communication
CC2.2.control: The entity internally communicates information, including control objectives and responsibilities.

objectives.text: The entity internally communicates information, including control objectives and responsibilities.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity internally communicates information, including control objectives and responsibilities.

CC2.3.title: External communication
CC2.3.control: The entity communicates with external parties about matters affecting internal control.

objectives.text: The entity communicates with external parties about matters affecting internal control.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity communicates with external parties about matters affecting internal control.

CC3.1.title: Objectives for risk
CC3.1.control: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable identification and assessment of risks.

objectives.text: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable identification and assessment of risks.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable identification and assessment of risks.

CC3.2.title: Identify and analyze risk
CC3.2.control: The entity identifies risks to its objectives and analyzes them as a basis for how to manage them.

objectives.text: The entity identifies risks to its objectives and analyzes them as a basis for how to manage them.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity identifies risks to its objectives and analyzes them as a basis for how to manage them.

CC3.3.title: Fraud risk
CC3.3.control: The entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks to objectives.

objectives.text: The entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks to objectives.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks to objectives.

CC3.4.title: Assess change
CC3.4.control: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact internal control.

objectives.text: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact internal control.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact internal control.

CC4.1.title: Evaluate controls
CC4.1.control: The entity selects, develops, and performs ongoing and separate evaluations of internal control.

objectives.text: The entity selects, develops, and performs ongoing and separate evaluations of internal control.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity selects, develops, and performs ongoing and separate evaluations of internal control.

CC4.2.title: Communicate deficiencies
CC4.2.control: The entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies to those responsible for corrective action.

objectives.text: The entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies to those responsible for corrective action.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies to those responsible for corrective action.

CC5.1.title: Control activities
CC5.1.control: The entity selects and develops control activities that mitigate risks to acceptable levels.

objectives.text: The entity selects and develops control activities that mitigate risks to acceptable levels.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity selects and develops control activities that mitigate risks to acceptable levels.

CC5.2.title: Technology controls
CC5.2.control: The entity selects and develops general control activities over technology.

objectives.text: The entity selects and develops general control activities over technology.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity selects and develops general control activities over technology.

CC5.3.title: Policies and procedures
CC5.3.control: The entity deploys control activities through policies and procedures that put them into action.

objectives.text: The entity deploys control activities through policies and procedures that put them into action.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity deploys control activities through policies and procedures that put them into action.

CC6.1.title: Logical access security
CC6.1.control: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures to protect information assets.

objectives.text: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures to protect information assets.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures to protect information assets.

CC6.2.title: Provisioning and review
CC6.2.control: The entity registers and authorizes users, provisions and deprovisions access, and reviews access rights.

objectives.text: The entity registers and authorizes users, provisions and deprovisions access, and reviews access rights.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity registers and authorizes users, provisions and deprovisions access, and reviews access rights.

CC6.3.title: Role-based least privilege
CC6.3.control: The entity authorizes, modifies, or removes access to data and functions based on roles and least privilege.

objectives.text: The entity authorizes, modifies, or removes access to data and functions based on roles and least privilege.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity authorizes, modifies, or removes access to data and functions based on roles and least privilege.

CC6.4.title: Physical access
CC6.4.control: The entity restricts physical access to facilities and protected information assets.

objectives.text: The entity restricts physical access to facilities and protected information assets.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity restricts physical access to facilities and protected information assets.

CC6.5.title: Secure disposal
CC6.5.control: The entity discontinues protections over assets only after the ability to read or recover data has been removed.

objectives.text: The entity discontinues protections over assets only after the ability to read or recover data has been removed.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity discontinues protections over assets only after the ability to read or recover data has been removed.

CC6.6.title: External threats
CC6.6.control: The entity implements logical access measures to protect against threats from outside its system boundaries.

objectives.text: The entity implements logical access measures to protect against threats from outside its system boundaries.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity implements logical access measures to protect against threats from outside its system boundaries.

CC6.7.title: Secure transmission
CC6.7.control: The entity restricts the movement of information to authorized users and protects it during transmission and removal.

objectives.text: The entity restricts the movement of information to authorized users and protects it during transmission and removal.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity restricts the movement of information to authorized users and protects it during transmission and removal.

CC6.8.title: Malicious software
CC6.8.control: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon unauthorized or malicious software.

objectives.text: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon unauthorized or malicious software.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon unauthorized or malicious software.

CC7.1.title: Vulnerability detection
CC7.1.control: The entity uses detection and monitoring to identify configuration changes and new vulnerabilities.

objectives.text: The entity uses detection and monitoring to identify configuration changes and new vulnerabilities.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity uses detection and monitoring to identify configuration changes and new vulnerabilities.

CC7.2.title: Anomaly monitoring
CC7.2.control: The entity monitors system components for anomalies indicative of malicious acts, errors, or disruptions.

objectives.text: The entity monitors system components for anomalies indicative of malicious acts, errors, or disruptions.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity monitors system components for anomalies indicative of malicious acts, errors, or disruptions.

CC7.3.title: Evaluate events
CC7.3.control: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could or did result in a failure to meet objectives.

objectives.text: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could or did result in a failure to meet objectives.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could or did result in a failure to meet objectives.

CC7.4.title: Incident response
CC7.4.control: The entity responds to identified security incidents through a defined program to contain, remediate, and communicate.

objectives.text: The entity responds to identified security incidents through a defined program to contain, remediate, and communicate.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity responds to identified security incidents through a defined program to contain, remediate, and communicate.

CC7.5.title: Recovery
CC7.5.control: The entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from identified security incidents.

objectives.text: The entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from identified security incidents.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from identified security incidents.

CC8.1.title: Change management
CC8.1.control: The entity authorizes, designs, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures.

objectives.text: The entity authorizes, designs, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity authorizes, designs, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures.

CC9.1.title: Business disruption risk
CC9.1.control: The entity identifies and develops risk mitigation activities for disruptions to business operations.

objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the entity identifies and develops risk mitigation activities for disruptions to business operations.
